The line graph illustrates the population of Chile devided into three age groups are 0-14, 15-64 and over 65, data taken from 1975 to 2035.

Overall, the figure of group from 15-64 years always the highest, it rised considerably and dip slighly at the end of period but never below half of Chile's population. At the second place, group 0-14 years was the only one consistenly decline. By contrast, group  65 years and over present a totally different pattern in which increased continuously over period.

Number of people between 15 and 64 initially was approximately over 50% in 1975, then continued to grow and reached its peak at roughly 70% in 2015. After that it fell to just nearly 60% by the end of period.

Group people from 0 to 14 years old was about 38% in 1975, after a remarkable drop in 1985 to just 30%, the population consistently decreased steadily and hit a low point of about 18% in 2035.

The last age group, people who is 65 and over only accounted for about 5% at the start of period and relatively stood still until 2005, then it increased stable year by year and almost equal to proportion of group 0-14 years.
